import java.lang.reflect.Field;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

/**
 * Stock-JVM proof of the stored segment list of M3StringTuple. M3StringTuple (head) and
 * M3StringTupleBase (base) are generated by run_proof.sh: a small stub header plus the member
 * text copied from the two sources. Oracle: the text of a tree expanded by plain recursion over
 * the stub leaves. Prints one row per check: name, cases, mismatches. Exit 1 on a mismatch or a
 * surviving discriminator.
 */
public final class SegmentListProof {
    private static final long SEED = 20261116L;
    private static final int RANDOM_TREES = 3_000;
    private static int failures;

    private SegmentListProof() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Random random = new Random(SEED);
        List<M3StringTuple> trees = new ArrayList<>();
        IntStream.range(0, RANDOM_TREES).forEach(index -> trees.add(randomTree(random, 1 + random.nextInt(40))));
        trees.add(chain(600, true));
        trees.add(chain(600, false));
        trees.add(doubled(12));
        report("charAt_every_index_vs_expanded_text", trees.stream().filter(tree -> !sameText(tree)).count(), trees.size());
        report("list_stored_once_and_well_formed", trees.stream().filter(tree -> !wellFormed(tree)).count(), trees.size());
        report("too_wide_tuple_keeps_the_descent", listOf(doubled(12)) == noSegments() ? 0 : 1, 1);
        report("short_leaf_walk_falls_back", guard(() -> M3StringLeafCursor.dropLast = true), 1);
        report("tuple_reported_as_leaf_falls_back", guard(() -> M3StringLeafCursor.reportTuple = true), 1);
        discriminator("search_with_greater_or_equal_is_wrong", mutantDiffers());
        long[] cost = readsPerUnit();
        System.out.println("owner_reads_per_unit_on_a_600_leaf_chain\tbase=" + cost[0] + "\thead=" + cost[1]);
        failures += cost[1] < cost[0] ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println("RESULT\t" + (failures == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + "\tfailures=" + failures);
        System.exit(failures == 0 ? 0 : 1);
    }

    private static M3String leaf(Random random) {
        char[] units = new char[random.nextInt(6)];
        IntStream.range(0, units.length).forEach(index -> units[index] = (char) ('a' + random.nextInt(26)));
        Leaf leaf = new Leaf(units);
        int start = units.length == 0 ? 0 : random.nextInt(units.length);
        return new M3String(leaf, start, random.nextInt(units.length - start + 1));
    }

    /** Whole and partial ranges of leaves and of earlier subtrees, joined in random order. */
    private static M3StringTuple randomTree(Random random, int joins) {
        List<M3String> pool = new ArrayList<>();
        IntStream.range(0, joins + 1).forEach(index -> pool.add(leaf(random)));
        M3StringTuple last = null;
        for (int join = 0; join < joins; join++) {
            M3String left = pool.get(random.nextInt(pool.size()));
            M3String right = pool.get(random.nextInt(pool.size()));
            last = new M3StringTuple(left, right);
            int start = last.length == 0 ? 0 : random.nextInt(last.length);
            pool.add(new M3String(last, 0, last.length));
            pool.add(new M3String(last, start, random.nextInt(last.length - start + 1)));
        }
        return last;
    }

    private static M3StringTuple chain(int leaves, boolean leftLeaning) {
        Random random = new Random(leaves);
        M3String text = leaf(random);
        M3StringTuple tuple = null;
        for (int index = 0; index < leaves; index++) {
            M3String next = new M3String(new Leaf(new char[] {(char) ('a' + index % 26), 'x'}), 0, 2);
            tuple = leftLeaning ? new M3StringTuple(text, next) : new M3StringTuple(next, text);
            text = new M3String(tuple, 0, tuple.length);
        }
        return tuple;
    }

    /** One leaf doubled {@code times} times: 2^times leaf ranges through shared subtrees. */
    private static M3StringTuple doubled(int times) {
        M3String text = new M3String(new Leaf(new char[] {'a', 'b', 'c'}), 0, 3);
        M3StringTuple tuple = null;
        for (int index = 0; index < times; index++) {
            tuple = new M3StringTuple(text, new M3String(text.owner(), text.start(), text.length()));
            text = new M3String(tuple, 0, tuple.length);
        }
        return tuple;
    }

    private static void expand(M3StringOwner owner, int start, int count, StringBuilder out) {
        if (owner instanceof M3StringTuple tuple) {
            int leftLength = tuple.left.length();
            int inLeft = Math.max(0, Math.min(count, leftLength - start));
            expand(tuple.left.owner(), tuple.left.start() + start, inLeft, out);
            expand(tuple.right.owner(), tuple.right.start() + Math.max(0, start - leftLength), count - inLeft, out);
        } else {
            IntStream.range(start, start + count).forEach(index -> out.append(owner.charAt(index)));
        }
    }

    private static boolean sameText(M3StringTuple tree) {
        StringBuilder expected = new StringBuilder();
        expand(tree, 0, tree.length, expected);
        return IntStream.range(0, tree.length).allMatch(index -> tree.charAt(index) == expected.charAt(index));
    }

    private static Object listOf(M3StringTuple tree) {
        try {
            if (tree.length > 0) tree.charAt(0);
            Field field = M3StringTuple.class.getDeclaredField("segments");
            field.setAccessible(true);
            return field.get(tree);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException failure) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(failure);
        }
    }

    private static Object noSegments() throws Exception {
        Field field = M3StringTuple.class.getDeclaredField("NO_SEGMENTS");
        field.setAccessible(true);
        return field.get(null);
    }

    /** A stored list has strictly increasing ends up to the length, and is the same object twice. */
    private static boolean wellFormed(M3StringTuple tree) {
        try {
            Object list = listOf(tree);
            if (tree.length == 0 || tree.height < 3) return list == null || list == noSegments();
            if (list == noSegments()) return true;
            M3StringTuple.Segments segments = (M3StringTuple.Segments) list;
            int[] ends = segments.ends;
            boolean rising = IntStream.range(1, ends.length).allMatch(index -> ends[index] > ends[index - 1]);
            return rising && ends[0] > 0 && ends[ends.length - 1] == tree.length && listOf(tree) == list;
        } catch (Exception failure) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(failure);
        }
    }

    /** With a misbehaving leaf walk the tuple must keep the descent and still read correctly. */
    private static long guard(Runnable misbehave) throws Exception {
        misbehave.run();
        M3StringTuple tree = chain(40, true);
        boolean ok = sameText(tree) && listOf(tree) == noSegments();
        M3StringLeafCursor.dropLast = false;
        M3StringLeafCursor.reportTuple = false;
        return ok ? 0 : 1;
    }

    private static boolean mutantDiffers() {
        int[] ends = {2, 5, 9};
        return IntStream.range(0, 9).anyMatch(index -> mutantSegmentOf(ends, index) != M3StringTuple.Segments.segmentOf(ends, index));
    }

    private static int mutantSegmentOf(int[] ends, int index) {
        int[] bounds = {0, ends.length - 1};
        while (bounds[0] < bounds[1]) {
            int middle = (bounds[0] + bounds[1]) >>> 1;
            if (ends[middle] >= index) bounds[1] = middle;
            else bounds[0] = middle + 1;
        }
        return bounds[0];
    }

    private static long[] readsPerUnit() {
        M3StringTuple head = chain(600, true);
        M3StringTupleBase base = M3StringTupleBase.chain(600);
        head.charAt(0);
        M3StringOwner.reads = 0;
        IntStream.range(0, base.length).forEach(base::charAt);
        long baseReads = M3StringOwner.reads / base.length;
        M3StringOwner.reads = 0;
        IntStream.range(0, head.length).forEach(head::charAt);
        return new long[] {baseReads, M3StringOwner.reads / head.length};
    }

    private static void report(String name, long mismatches, int cases) {
        failures += mismatches == 0 ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println(name + "\t" + cases + "\t" + mismatches);
    }

    private static void discriminator(String name, boolean detected) {
        failures += detected ? 0 : 1;
        System.out.println("discriminator:" + name + "\t1\t" + (detected ? "KILLED" : "SURVIVED"));
    }
}
